# Historical citation sources

These seven text files are immutable copies of the source needed to verify the eleven external file lookups listed in `documents.json`. The manifest keys each copy by the historical goinfer commit and cited path. Its upstream module, release, recorded Go sum, line count and SHA-256 identify the source. The files were read from the modules at the versions required by the historical goinfer commits. `LICENSE` preserves the upstream MIT grant. These files are evidence for the citation lint and are outside Go's buildable package tree.
